title: Uncle Sylvester with Bucket Outside House, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Black and white vintage snapshot taken on July 18, 1948, depicting an older gentleman identified on the back as 'Uncle Sylvester'. He stands outside a home featuring light-colored brick siding and a concrete block basement foundation, holding a metal bucket beneath a tap or hook near the basement window. Captured in mid-20th century post-WWII America, this image presents a clear slice of everyday family history.
